title: Jehoiada crowns Jehoash and kills Athaliah
description: The priest Jehoiada leads a successful coup in the seventh year, where the young Joash is crowned king in the house of the Lord. The wicked queen Athaliah is taken out and killed at the Horse Gate. Then Jehoiada makes a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people, the temple of Baal is torn down, and Mattan, the priest of Baal, is killed.
